title: LightCarbon Super Light Road Frame LCR007 V Unboxing

takeaways.text: The only niggle is the proprietary D-shaped seatpost with grip tape and an apparent alloy core; spares may be hard to find in future, though his has had no problems in three years.
Weighed uncut: zero-offset seatpost 215 g and fork 368 g; he sizes the 52 like a 56 cm from other brands at 183 cm.
Internal routing has guides that make fishing cables easy; it uses a proprietary seat clamp and a press-fit BB86 bottom bracket.
He rates the finish equal to premium brands and, having owned an S-Works SL7, finds the LCR007-V stiffer and lighter-building; a strongly opinionated, subjective comparison.

disclosure: No supply arrangement is stated; the presenter says he has ridden the same frameset for three years.
summary: Unboxing and weigh-in of a size-52 rim-brake LightCarbon LCR007-V frameset by a rider who has used the model for three years.
